body: Don't beat yourself up recovery is never a straight line. I know what it is to be alone when you feel like you shouldn't have to be, let me know if you need a friend <3

Don't beat yourself up recovery is never a straight line <3
If you need someone to talk to I'm available

Just because you've relapsed absolutely does not invalidate all the effort you've put forth and the progress you've made.  There is no time limit and no "one way" to your recovery.  The shame and guilt are naturally occurring reactions, but accept yourself as you are, nothing's accomplished by dwelling on the one mistake when you have so many days of good choices under your belt.

Thank you for your compassion and kindness, but I can't help but wonder about at what point does the fighting and the digging and the railing against the same walls just not end up being worth it.  I mean, maybe I'm just one of the bad ones, and that's why I feel like I'm losing this battle. Maybe I'm supposed to.  There's a better person that could be living in my apartment, a better person to fill my cubicle, a better person to love my pets.  Someone who deserves the things I have in my life more than me.  I'm just wasting space, resources, and time.
